name: Chris Tham
headline: Strategy Consultant | Technology Strategy, Architecture and Business Change
summary: Founder of Hello Tham, a boutique strategy consulting company. Available for short to medium term consulting engagements spanning strategic business change, business and operating model design, business process improvement, and technology strategy, architecture and solutions.

achievements.title: Flexible strategic change agent and thought leader
achievements.detail: Organisations bring me in when business and technology need to change together. I have been doing that work for nearly three decades: leading IT strategy and operating model change from the inside as an executive at MLC, NAB and ING, then from the outside as a consultant to Transfield Services and Transport for NSW. Since 2016 I have delivered it through Hello Tham, the consultancy I founded.

achievements.title: Successful and proven technology strategy and architecture leader
achievements.detail: I build architecture functions from the ground up. I did it first at MLC, where I wrote my own job description and built a practice that became a case study at international conferences; then at NAB, where I created a new function for the distribution business; and again at ING, where I re-established strategy and architecture as a team of twenty. My current engagement is with Cochlear, as their consulting Enterprise Architect.

achievements.title: Recognised technology innovator and industry expert
achievements.detail: I get to new technology early. The service-oriented advice platform I pioneered at MLC and NAB earned NAB a software patent, and I put a large language model to work classifying support calls in 2018, long before AI was on every roadmap. Today I shape AI architecture for Cochlear as a consultant, teach Information Systems at Torrens University, and have written AI-dō, a book on working with AI.
